title: 第17章 给十岁小孩施加真爱诅咒第18章 违和的盛大舞会虚假的完美结局
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
已经恢复了人类身体的卢米亚，此时正指着地图上的某一块领土，介绍道：
“这里的恩泽尔郡如何？这里是亲王直属领地，非常富庶，每年光是税收就有三万金币！”
“只要您同意，王子殿下现在就能以家族继承人的身份册封您为恩泽尔伯爵！”
在游戏前期，能拿到伯爵这个级别的爵位已经不错了。
而且李凯南对这个也没有多么重视，反正也就临时过渡一下，最后他还是会自立的！
不过就在李凯南要点头同意的时候，坐在他旁边的贝儿却是忽然指着卢米亚手中的地图开口道：
“可是这些亲王直属领地，早在十年之前就已经陆续被人给瓜分了！”
刚要点头的李凯南闻言，不由扭过头来看向了坐在自己身旁的贝儿。
而且相较于一直和家人生活在瑞普森林深处的布兰妮，贝儿显然对如今天下局势更加了解。
自己一开始还真就是猜错了，本以为是战斗型招募伙伴。
现在一看，她居然是一位偏向外交、政务型的人才……
……
而站在对面的卢米亚听到贝儿这话，下意识就反驳道：
“怎么可能！地图上的都是属于亚当亲王家族的领地，王室绝对不可能坐视一位王室直系亲王的领地被人随意瓜分……”
可是卢米亚刚一提到王室，便忽然意识到了什么。
他话语猛地一滞，想到了某种可能，转而脸上露出了惊悚的表情。
他们在被施加魔法之前，就听闻了整座卡佩王宫都因为女巫的诅咒而被封锁起来。
自家王子当时虽然年龄还小，但作为王室直系亲王，已经准备打出旗号，号召卡佩王国的所有贵族组织力量拯救王室。
只是才刚刚借着举办宴会的名义召集直属封臣商议大事的时候，就和王室一样被女巫所诅咒……
所以难道已经过去了十年，王宫依旧没有解除诅咒？

野兽王子此时浑身缠着绷带，就坐在旁边。
野兽化的身体就是比人类身体更加强大壮硕，再加上李凯南并没有全力出手，他伤势不轻但并没有性命之危。
不过在听到贝儿和卢米亚的对话之后，野兽王子神情顿时恍惚起来，喃喃自语道：
“怪不得这十年来，王室没有能够组织力量前来救我……”
“卡佩王国，现在是不是已经灭亡了？”
贝儿摇了摇头，继续道：
“并没有，几年前还有一些野心勃勃的大贵族自立为王，但这些人要么兵败被流放，要么就是因为各种疾病和意外而死去。”
“如今的卡佩王位，已经被誉为‘被诅咒的王冠’，没有贵族再敢轻易自立为王。各大贵族势力相互牵制，这使得卡佩王国在名义上还依旧存在着……”
听到这里，李凯南却是忍不住对着贝儿问道：
“按理说王室遇难，难道就没有人推举有王室血脉的贵族成为新王，重新让国家恢复统一吗？”
此前在知晓了卡佩王国因为失去国王而彻底大乱，李凯南心中就有这个疑惑。
在西方中世界这种故事背景设定之下，王室绝嗣的事情也常有发生。
按理来说，整个王国行政体系对于这种事情应该是有相应应对策略的啊！
贝儿扭头正好就对上了李凯南那好奇疑惑的眼神，
content_en:
Lumia, who had recovered her human body, was pointing at a certain territory on the map and introduced:
"How about Enzel County here? This is the territory directly under the prince's jurisdiction. It is very wealthy. The annual tax revenue alone is 30,000 gold coins!"
"As long as you agree, His Highness the Prince can now canonize you as Count Enzel as the heir of the family!"
In the early stages of the game, it is already good to get a title of earl level.
And Li Kainan doesn't pay much attention to this. Anyway, it's just a temporary transition. In the end, he will be independent!
But just when Li Kainan was about to nod in agreement, Bei'er, who was sitting next to him, suddenly pointed at the map in Lumia's hand and said:
"But these territories directly under the prince's jurisdiction have been divided up one after another ten years ago!"
Li Kainan, who was about to nod, couldn't help but turn his head and look at Belle sitting next to him.
And compared to Britney, who has been living with her family in the depths of Rip Forest, Belle obviously understands the current world situation better.
I really guessed wrong at first. I thought I was recruiting a combat partner.
Looking at it now, she is actually a talent who prefers diplomacy and government affairs...
…
When Lumia standing opposite heard Belle's words, she subconsciously retorted:
"How is it possible! All the territories on the map belong to the family of Prince Adam. It is absolutely impossible for the royal family to sit back and watch the territory of a direct prince of the royal family be divided up at will..."
But as soon as Lumia mentioned the royal family, she suddenly realized something.
His words suddenly stopped as he thought of some possibility, and then a horrified expression appeared on his face.
Before they were enchanted, they heard that the entire Capetian palace was sealed off due to the witch's curse.
Although his prince was still young at the time, as the direct prince of the royal family, he was already ready to raise a banner and call on all the nobles of the Capetian Kingdom to organize their efforts to save the royal family.
But just when he summoned his direct vassals to discuss important matters in the name of holding a banquet, he was cursed by a witch like the royal family...
So has it been ten years and the palace still hasn’t lifted the curse?
The Beast Prince was now covered in bandages and was sitting next to him.
The beast-like body is stronger and stronger than the human body. In addition, Li Kainan did not attack with all his strength. His injuries were serious but not life-threatening.
However, after hearing the conversation between Belle and Lumia, the Beast Prince suddenly became dazed and muttered to himself:
"No wonder the royal family has not been able to organize forces to rescue me in the past ten years..."
"Is the Capetian Kingdom destroyed now?"
Belle shook her head and continued:
"No, a few years ago there were some ambitious nobles who proclaimed themselves kings, but these people were either defeated and exiled, or died of various diseases and accidents."
"Today's Capetian throne has been hailed as the 'cursed crown'. No nobleman dares to proclaim himself king easily anymore. The major noble forces restrain each other, which makes the Capetian Kingdom still exist in name..."
Hearing this, Li Kainan couldn't help but asked Belle:
"It stands to reason that if the royal family is in trouble, wouldn't anyone elect a noble with royal blood to become the new king and restore the unity of the country?"
After learning that the Cape Kingdom was in complete chaos due to the loss of its king, Li Kainan had this doubt in his mind.
In the setting of the story in the Western Middle World, the death of the royal family often happens.
Logically speaking, the entire kingdom's administrative system should have corresponding strategies to deal with this kind of thing!
Belle turned her head and met Li Kainan's curious and doubtful eyes.
